### [`sfx_v2_state`](../../../src/sfx_voice2.asm#L6) `$EF70`

*variable*

Sound id that plays on channel 1 (0 = free).
bit7 set = start sound effect bits0-6; 1 = playing; 0 = idle

<a id="sfx_v2_update"></a>
### [`sfx_v2_update`](../../../src/sfx_voice2.asm#L13) `$EF73`

*routine*
